purpose: Descriptors of the kinds whose new object the Configurator fills in its own way, as it writes them right after interactive creation. A new language takes the first free numbered code ru1, ru2 from the Configurator's interface language, whatever the languages of the configuration. Location, Use and Documents stay empty: the platform will not load these kinds until the property is set. object.create writes the same bytes; loading such a dump refuses with «Не установлено Хранение функциональной опции», «Не установлено Использование параметра функциональной опции» and «Не один документ не участвует в последовательности».

steps.tool: Configurator, interactive: add the object and save the configuration
